stops.name: Nelson Piquet
stops.note: 'Prost duplicated Mansell's move on lap 42. Two laps later Nelson dived into the pits' for a set of Cs (vibration)

notes: Senna (#27) gambled on no stop and retired with a right-rear tyre failure (Wikipedia: three laps after Prost passed him on lap 60; GrandPrix.com: lap 63; Jolpica: 63 laps). Prost (#1) and Mansell (#2): no stop reported in Motor Sport, GrandPrix.com or Wikipedia, but none states they ran non-stop. Larini (#25) 'had also stopped early for fresh rubber' (no lap).
